summary: Positive, medium conviction. Cloud and TPUs are turning AI spending into a second profit engine while Search holds up; the debate is whether ~$200B+ of annual capex earns a return before FCF and dilution erode the equity story.
statement: Alphabet's full-stack AI position (Gemini, TPU, Cloud, Search distribution) lets it grow revenue ~20% through 2027 with stable ~32% operating margins; once 2027 TPU deliveries and Cloud backlog convert to cash, FCF recovers and the market re-rates the shares from ~19x toward ~24x forward earnings.

pillars.title: Cloud becomes a second profit engine
pillars.expectation: Cloud revenue growth above 50% through 2027 with segment margin of at least 30%
pillars.evidence: Q3 2026 Cloud revenue +103% to $30.7B, operating income $11.1B (~36% margin), backlog about $561B.

pillars.title: Search stays resilient through the AI transition
pillars.expectation: Search & other grows at least high single digits as AI Overviews/AI Mode add queries
pillars.evidence: Q3 Search & other +12% (vs +15% a year ago), roughly flat QoQ; management cites the highest query growth in five years.

pillars.title: AI capex earns a return and FCF recovers
pillars.expectation: Capex intensity peaks in 2027 and FCF turns positive again on a trailing basis by late 2027
pillars.evidence: Q3 capex $51.4B, FCF -$9.1B (second negative quarter), FY2026 guide $195–205B, 2027 to rise significantly; buybacks halted and equity/debt issued.

pillars.title: Full-stack AI stays competitive
pillars.expectation: Gemini keeps frontier parity and TPUs win external customers
pillars.evidence: Gemini app ~1B users; external TPU customers include Apple; offset by the Gemini 3.5 Pro delay and related securities suit.

pillars.title: Antitrust remedies stay behavioral
pillars.expectation: No forced divestiture of Chrome, Android or AdX, and default-placement payments survive appeal
pillars.evidence: Search remedies (Sept 2025) and ad-tech remedies (Sept 2026) rejected breakups; D.C. Circuit argument on the search cross-appeals expected January 2027.

risks.title: Capex overbuild / depreciation squeeze
risks.trigger: 2027 capex guide well above $300B without a matching step-up in Cloud backlog, or consolidated operating margin below 28%

risks.title: AI cannibalizes search monetization
risks.trigger: Search & other growth below 5% YoY, or paid-click metrics turning negative

risks.title: Appeal strengthens search remedies
risks.trigger: D.C. Circuit orders a Chrome divestiture or bans default-placement payments

risks.title: Dilution and leverage
risks.trigger: Further ATM/equity issuance beyond the remaining $27.6B, or net cash turning negative

risks.title: Earnings noise from investment marks
risks.trigger: Large swings in OI&E from public stakes such as Anthropic (began trading Nov 19, 2026)

falsifiers: Search & other revenue growth below 5% YoY for two consecutive quarters.
Google Cloud segment operating margin below 20% for a full quarter.
FY2027 guidance or results implying negative free cash flow for full-year 2027 and 2028.
A final ruling that forces divestiture of Chrome or Android, or bans default search payments.

fair_value.method: Low 20x / base 24x our FY2027E EPS of $13.40; high 26x consensus $14.92
